Name: THE StonerVille Mod 2.0
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[size=6][font=sans-serif][u][b]🌿✨ StonerVille 2.0 ✨🌿[/b][/u][/font][/size]
A cozy, magical marijuana-themed expansion for Stardew Valley 1.6 💚

[i][u]FULL RELEASE (only basic/necessary fixes from here out folks!)[/u][/i]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]🆕 NEW IN STONERVILLE 2.0! 🆕[/size][/u][/b]
• 🎁 Blunt Packs & Pre-roll Packs: put 3 blunts (or 5 joints) in the Rolling Table, up to 4 packs at once. The Packing Table now takes blunts too.
• 🍵 Calm Tea is a kitchen recipe: 1 dried bud + 1 Sugar = 2 cups. Recipes with milk or eggs now take ANY milk or egg.
• 💬 Smoke sesh guests walk in from the entrance (no more popping in), and chatting with them really counts: up to +60 friendship and a Good company buff.
• 📱 Puffr statuses: post a random status and watch villagers like and comment. Your own profile picture shows on every post.
• 🛋️ New street: walk into the Tasting House, sit on the bean bags and stools around a solid fire pit.
• 🪑 Furniture previews stay fully visible while you place them, and the Mushroom Floor Lamp no longer shrinks.
• 🧶 12 hemp products, 4 mini bongs, 12 craftable garden decor pieces, the Beverage Counter (8 colors), Request Boards (7 colors), the Dispensary Sign and 4 tie-dye tees. Showcase images for every new item are in the gallery!
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]🌈 WHAT IS IT?[/size][/u][/b]
Grow 30 custom strains 🌱 (including 12 you breed yourself 🧬), process them in dozens of hand-drawn machines ⚙️, roll joints 🚬, press rosin 🍯, grind, press hash 🧱, sell to your neighbors 💰, take orders by letter 💌, keep an eye on your Dealer Rep with a sticky note 📝, share a hookah with the villagers 🪷, and throw the Higher Vibez Festival 🎉, build your own Stoner's Shed 🏠 with gypsy hippy furniture 🛏️. All wrapped in a COMPLETE green-to-lilac tie-dye UI 🌈 with an animated main menu 🍃
💰 Always affordable: seeds 20-45g (Chocolate Mint 120g), machines 150-350g at Pierre's.
🎮 Mouse, keyboard AND controller all work.
🌍 Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, Lilybrook & other villager mods.
🚫 Kids & teens are never involved in anything smoking-related.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]📋 REQUIREMENTS[/size][/u][/b]
• 🧩 SMAPI 4.x
• 📦 Content Patcher
• 🎮 Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer
• ✨ Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu
📁 ONE download, ONE folder: StonerVille_AllInOne (content pack + C# add-on). Drop the whole folder into Mods!
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]🌱 THE GROW LOOP[/size][/u][/b]
🌱 Plant → 🌿 Harvest → ☀️ Dry on a Rack → 🫙 Cure in a Jar → 💨 Smoke it, 💰 sell it, 🍪 bake it, or ✨ craft something better!
• 🍃 8 core strains: Northern Lights, Girl Scout Cookies, Pineapple Express, Blue Dream, Lemon Haze, Strawberry Cough, Sunset Sherbet, Chocolate Mint
• ❄️ 4 winter strains: Frostbite Kush, Snowcap Haze, Peppermint Frost, Golden Eggnog (they only grow in Winter)
• 🧬 12 hybrids you breed yourself (see Crossbreeding below)
• 🍫 Chocolate Mint is the rare one. Its seeds unlock at Dealer Rep 3!
• 🌸 Fresh, Dried & Cured buds for every strain. Cured buds are gold quality!
• 📦 Batch processing: Racks, Jars, the Rosin Press & the Grinder take your whole stack; the Rolling Table lets you choose the batch. N in, N out (20 / 10 / 6 / 4 / 2 / 1)
Every strain has a lean and a terpene (see the Strain Dex) that adds a buff when you smoke, and rare phenos can appear when you cross Berry Dream, Golden Aurora or Frosted Lemon.
• 🎛️ Config: seed prices, growing seasons, drying, curing & cooking times
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]🧬 CROSSBREEDING (NEW!)[/size][/u][/b]
Build a Cross Station (Cabinet or Terrarium look, your choice!). Put in one cured bud, then a cured bud of a different strain. 3 days later out come seeds!
• 🌟 Berry Dream = Strawberry Cough + Blue Dream
• 🌟 Tropical Sunset = Pineapple Express + Sunset Sherbet
• 🌟 Cookies & Cream = Girl Scout Cookies + Snowcap Haze
• 🌟 Frosted Lemon = Lemon Haze + Frostbite Kush
• 🌟 Golden Aurora = Northern Lights + Golden Eggnog
• 🌟 Peppermint Punch = Peppermint Frost + Strawberry Cough
• 💌 Make a hybrid for the first time and a discovery note arrives in your mail
• 🎲 Any other pair gives 2 seeds of one of the parents
• 🍯 Every hybrid has the full chain: buds, joints, edibles, rosin, hash and more
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]💌 LETTERS & ORDERS (BIG UPDATE!)[/size][/u][/b]
Your mailbox is now your order desk! Every request arrives as a LETTER, and every letter is kept in your Letters (collections tab) so you can re-read it any time.
• 🖼️ Each letter shows the villager's portrait, what they want, how many, the exact gold they will pay and the day it is due
• 🌿 Villagers only ask for what is IN SEASON, so you are never asked for something you can't grow or make
• 🌸 Plain bud is always requested CURED. Others ask for joints, edibles, tea and (later) concentrates
• 📅 Every Monday (from day 7) up to 4 villagers who like you (2+ hearts) write a regular order
• ✅ Fill an order two ways: hold the items, talk to the villager and choose Fill order, OR use the town boards (below)
• 💰 Pay = sell price + a bonus that grows with your Dealer Rep. Happy customers like you more
• 🗣️ 30 cozy request lines and 20 thank-yous, so letters never feel copy-pasted
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]🪧 BUYER NOTICES ON THE TOWN BOARDS (NEW!)[/size][/u][/b]
Walk up to the Help Wanted board OR the Special Orders board by Pierre's and choose Buyer notices. Your open orders pin up as notes with a Fill button that hands in the items straight from your backpack. Works with mouse, keyboard and controller!
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]🛍️ SELL TO YOUR NEIGHBORS[/size][/u][/b]
Hold any StonerVille product and talk to an adult villager: Share it / Sell it / Give as gift.
• 📈 Price grows with your Dealer Rep (+10% up to +70%) and with how much they like the item
• 🚫 Villagers who dislike it won't buy. Up to 2 items per villager per day
• 🏪 Pierre buys as a shopkeeper at the normal price
• 🌍 Every adult villager from vanilla and modded towns can be sold to (kids & teens never)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]🕴️ DEALER ORDERS & REPUTATION[/size][/u][/b]
12 dealer orders arrive as letters from Pam, Shane, Leah, Sebastian, Willy, Gus & Marnie (the first lands after day 5, the next the day after you finish the last). Each asks for cured bud of a strain that is in season.
• 🌱 Rep 1: starting out, customers pay +10%
• 📈 Rep 2 after order 3: +20% and the Cross Station
• 🍫 Rep 3 after order 6: +30%, Chocolate Mint seeds, the Hash Press
• 🎁 Rep 4 after order 9: +40% and the Packing Table
• 👑 Kingpin after order 12: +50%, the top of the valley
• 💌 Every rise comes with a story letter
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]📝 THE DEALER REP STICKY NOTE (NEW!)[/size][/u][/b]
Not sure where you stand? A sticky note lives in the LOWER RIGHT corner of your screen once your first dealer order arrives. It always shows:
• 🏷️ Your Dealer Rep level
• 💰 How much customers pay at your level
• ➡️ How many more orders until the next level
• ⭕ 12 little squares that fill in as you complete orders
• 📮 Your current open order
It hides itself during menus, cutscenes and festivals, so it never gets in the way.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]⚙️ MACHINES[/size][/u][/b]
• 🪜 Drying Rack & Dark Wood Rack · 150g
• 🫙 Curing Jar · 250g
• 🫧 Bong & Pastel Bong · 350g
• 🌈 Hippie & Pastel Seed Makers · 150g
• 🍯 Rosin Press · 300g
• 💎 Dab Rig & Pastel Dab Rig · 350g (load Rosin, get a Dab Hit buff)
• 🧈 Infusion Pot · 200g (1 dried bud + any milk = Cannabutter)
• 🪑 Rolling Table · 200g & 📜 Rolling Papers · 20g (it always asks what to roll (Joints, Blunts or Dealer's Special, then how many) and only uses the CURED buds you choose)
• 🍪 Edibles Oven · 150g & ✨ Golden Oven · 250g (butter edibles), both cook from DRIED buds
• ⚙️ Grinder · 250g (cured bud to Ground Flower to Kief)
• 🧱 Hash Press · 300g (Rep 3) and 🎁 Packing Table · 200g (Rep 4) for Hash and Gift Baskets
• 🧬 Cross Station (Cabinet & Terrarium) · 350g (Rep 2)
• 🪷 Trippy Hookah · 600g, 2x2 (see below)
• 🫙 Stash Jar · 200g (a chest you can carry) with strain labels, and 📚 Stash Shelf & Lilac Shelf · 250g (display 4 things each: jars, stash boxes, rosin, edibles, joints, blunts and more)
• 🏕️ Garden Tent · 300g at Robin's, two grow slots, grows in about 60% of the time
• 🚬 Ashtray · 200g (5 Roaches = a Roach Joint)
🍪 Edibles: Brownie, Cookie, Gummies, Swirl Lollipop and Calm Tea, plus Butter versions, each with its own buff. Every strain makes exactly one edible.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]🛍️ EVERYTHING YOU CAN MAKE[/size][/u][/b]
🌿 FROM EVERY STRAIN (30 of them!)
• 🌱 Seeds → 🌸 Fresh bud → ☀️ Dried bud → ✨ Cured bud (gold quality)
• 🚬 A unique Joint for each strain, with its own look & buff
• 🍪 One edible per strain
⚙️ FROM YOUR MACHINES
• 🍯 Rosin (Rosin Press) and 💎 Dab Hits (Dab Rigs)
• ⚪ Ground Flower and 🌫️ Kief (Grinder)
• 🧱 Hash (Hash Press)
• 🧈 Cannabutter (Infusion Pot) and Butter Edibles (Golden Oven)
• 🍪 Brownies, Cookies, Gummies, Swirl Lollipops & Calm Tea (Edibles Oven)
• 🍂 Blunts, 🍫 Dealer's Special, 🎁 Pre-roll Packs, 🪙 Roach Joints (Rolling Table & Ashtray)
• 🎁 Gift Baskets (Packing Table)
• 🧬 Seeds of brand-new hybrids (Cross Station)
• 🫧 Bong rips (Bong & Pastel Bong)
• 🪷 Hookah sessions with friends
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]🚬 ROLL YOUR OWN[/size][/u][/b]
• 🌿 A joint for every strain, each with its own look & buff
• 🍂 Blunt: 2 cured buds, a big 10 minute buff
• 🍫 Dealer's Special: 2 cured Chocolate Mint, the best there is
• 🎁 Pre-roll Pack: 5 joints in a tube
• 🪙 Roaches & Lighters: sometimes a roach is left behind, and a Lighter makes buffs last 25% longer
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]🫶 SHARE A JOINT & 🪷 THE HOOKAH[/size][/u][/b]
• Hold a joint, blunt or Dealer's Special and interact with an adult villager. Some LOVE it, some join in, some politely decline (nothing lost!)
• 👀 Joiners get a touch of redness in their eyes on the portrait, during their reply only
• 🪷 The Trippy Hookah: take a rip with a cured bud and up to 3 friendly adults nearby join your circle with a groovy line. A small farming buff for you, friendship for them!
• ☁️ Every smokable plays a fluffy cloud & rainbow sparkle effect
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]🎉 THE HIGHER VIBEZ FESTIVAL (Summer 7)[/size][/u][/b]
• 🎪 A tie-dye stage, jumbo animated lava lamps, speakers that pulse, a market and a decor stall, balloon arches, bean bags and mushroom stools
• 🏆 Smoking contest: hold the button, release in the sweet zone. 1st place wins 500g, rare seeds and the Golden Spliff Trophy
• 🍽️ Free buffet with the Munchies Satisfied buff, a Snack Table shop, and a west court with bongs
• 🎡 Main square: Prize Wheel (first spin free, jackpot is Hash), Photo Booth (saves a tie-dye photo and gives a Luck buff), a big hookah and 12 tie-dye bean bags
• 🎤 Guests Dawgy Kong, Chonk & Cheeba, plus surprise celebs Granny Bloom, DJ Haze & Professor Puff at noon. Share a joint with them for a prize!
• 💃 Villagers dance, nap, browse the stalls, chat and cheer. Every adult attends in festival accessories
• 💌 An invitation letter arrives on Summer 6
• ✅ Works with heavily modded Town maps
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=4][u][b]🏠 THE STONER'S SHED (NEW!)[/b][/u][/size]
A free farm building from Robin's Carpenter shop, ready in 1 day. Walk right up the porch steps to the door and press the action button or click to go in.
• 🏡 Two big rooms to make your own: a huge square main room (12 x 12 with the wall) with NOTHING in it, and a giant side room with a stone fireplace. Every floor tile takes furniture and every wall tile can be decorated
• 🎨 Both rooms start in plum plank floors and botanical wallpaper, and each room's walls and floor can be re-papered and re-floored on their own
• 🔥 Fireplaces light themselves when you walk in: animated flames, a soft warm glow and faint floor shadows. The chimney puffs lilac smoke
• 🪟 Working windows: the sky changes outside the glass, sunbeams fall across the floor by day and soft moonlight at night
• 🚪 Funny doormats: HIGH THERE! outside and BACK IN 5 OR 50 inside
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[u][b][size=4]🛏️ GYPSY HIPPY FURNITURE & WALLPAPER (NEW!)[/size][/b][/u]
Sold at Robin's Carpenter shop. Warm cottage-core hobo style, all sized small to fit a cozy room.
• 🛌 Beds (all sleepable from the left or the right side, can sit against a wall with a nightstand beside): Wagon Bed, Patchwork Iron Bed, Kilim Floor Bed
• 🧺 Bedroom: Trunk & Plain Wooden Nightstands (one tile, items and boxes sit ON them), Painted Trunk Dresser & Wardrobe (working dressers), Beaded Mirror Vanity, Tarnished Floor Mirror, Moroccan Lantern Lamp, Hat & Coat Stand
• 🛋️ Living room (all sittable): Patchwork Settee, Tasselled Daybed, Patchwork Armchair, Kilim Cushion Circle, plus Spool & Crate Table, Gramophone Cabinet, Crate Bookcase, Potbelly Stove (animated fire that lights the room, sits on a concrete slab), Samovar Tea Cart and Busker's Corner
• 🖼️ 13 wallpapers and 12 floors for indoors
• 🪧 8 retro diner wall signs: Today's Special A Nap, Back In 5 Or 50, Eat Pie, Hot Stuff, Munch, No Shirt No Shoes No Problem, Secret Menu and Chill
• 🔮 Crystal Bead Curtain and the Hippy House Clutter set (also Robin's)
• 🍳 Optional StonerVille kitchen for the farmhouse kitchen (turn on UseKitchenOverride in the Content Patcher config): teal cabinets, terracotta checker floor, cast-iron stove, mint fridge. Counters hold items
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📦 STASH CONTAINERS & STASH BOXES (NEW!)
Craftable from the start and sold at Robin's Carpenter shop.
• 🫙 4 stash containers with live labels: Joint Canister, Blunt Humidor, Hash Tin and Rosin Jar. Each only takes its own kind. The Joint Canister label shows the strain code and color, the others show how many are inside
• 🗄️ Apothecary Tower (Pierre's 500g or crafted): three shelves with back and front rows, 24 spots for jars, boxes, chests and machines at half size. Using it lists everything on its shelves so you can pick one to open, fill, collect from or take down. Curing Jars keep curing on the shelf Machines, shelves and furniture can stand flush against the shed walls.
• Eight hippie rugs (Peace & Daisies, Trippy Swirl, Granny Square, Groovy Sun, Flower Power, Leaf & Tie-Dye, Paisley Parade, Rainbow & Clouds) at the clutter shop.
• 🗃️ 6 Stash Boxes (Walnut, Cherry, Ebony, plus pastel Lavender, Mint and Peach) with brass trim and a lockable lid. A box holds Stash Jars, the containers, loose buds, single joints, blunts, Dealer's Specials, hash, rosin and accessories (ashtray, lighter, pipes, papers, roaches, grinder, bongs, dab rigs)
• 🕯️ Boxes, containers and incense burners can be placed ON TOP of nightstands, end tables and tables and rest on the table top with a little shadow
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[size=4][u][b]🪈 HAND PIPES & THE STRAIN TASTING TENT (NEW!)[/b][/u][/size]
• 🪈 4 Hand Pipes at Pierre's (250g): Cosmic, Sunset Ember, Forest Moss and Tie-Dye Festival. Use one to smoke a cured bud of ANY strain from your bag and get that strain's joint buff for 5 minutes, with a full animation. Adult villagers use pipes around town too, never kids or teens
• 🏕️ Festival: a walk-in Strain Tasting Tent with 12 jars of real buds, and a Chill Zone with an animated fire pit, tie-dye bean bags and mushroom stools
• 🃏 Tasting Card popup (K, right stick click or the tent counters) to taste and track strains
• 🧬 6 new strains: Granddaddy Purple, Mango Kush, Cherry Pie, Honey Chamomile, Sour Apple and winter-only Hot Cocoa Kush, plus 6 new crosses: Purple Punch, Mango Tango, Cherry Pop, Chamomile Dusk, Caramel Apple and Mint Mocha. A special prize strain comes from the festival
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]🌾 HEMP & TOPICALS (NEW!)[/size][/u][/b]
Hemp is a fibre crop with no high, nothing to smoke, and no new machines: it uses the vanilla Loom, Oil Maker and Seed Maker.
• 🌱 Hemp Seeds (40g at Pierre's): spring, summer or fall, 8 days, harvest a Hemp Stalk
• 🧵 Loom: Hemp Stalk to Hemp Cloth. Oil Maker: Hemp Seed to Hemp Seed Oil. Seed Maker: Hemp Stalk to Hemp Seed
• 🪢 Craft Hemp Rope (2 Stalks), Hemp Rug and Hemp Hammock (furniture)
• 🧴 Hemp Salve, Hemp Lotion and Hemp Bath Bomb, crafted from Infused Olive Oil with Honey, Milk or a Sweet Pea
• All hemp recipes are known from the start, and everything is in The Stoner's Bible
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[u][b][size=4]🔥 THE PHONE 🔥 [/size][/b][/u]
🌾 Pierre sells a Phone for 600g. Open it with a hotkey (default P, controller: left stick click) or hold it and click. Twelve working apps (with 🌋 Buzz, the villagers' feed, and the Bank): Dealer upgrades, Requests (deliver orders), Strain Dex, Machines, Puffr (friends, vibes, matches, smoke sesh invites), Music, Smoulder (adult romance: flirt, gifts, dates, be exclusive) and Settings (23 wallpapers, banners, and switches for the Dealer Rep sticky note and the order letters). Controller: D-pad, A, B for back, LB/RB tabs. 
The phone also has a Bank app: savings with interest, locked deposits, loans tied to Dealer Rep (Rep goes up to 9: Plug, Insider, Boss, Legend, with 24 story orders and the Express Courier upgrade), a savings goal, and customers who sometimes pay orders into your account.
🪴 Buzz is a feed where adult villagers post about their own lives, reply to each other and to you, like posts and send you messages with choices. 
🌋 You only need to buy the Phone once: it never has to stay in your bag. A custom chime plays for every phone notification. A small corner phone shows in the lower left with wiggle, glow and floating hearts when a notification arrives.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][u][size=4]🏡 DECOR, WEARABLES & MORE[/size][/u][/b]
• 🌋 8 Lava Lamps with flowing lava, a click to switch them on or off (flicker fixed!)
• 🛏️ Hippie Leaf Bed replaces your starter bed
• 🪴 4 Hanging Plants and 4 Incense Burners with real smoke (floor or table)
• 🛋️ 6 floor-to-ceiling animated Bubble Tubes plus 4 slow Lava Lamp Tubes (neon glow, pot leaf wall shadows, switch on and off like the lava lamps), Slouch Beanbag, Tie-Dye Rug, Blacklight Poster, Bead Curtain (hangs over windows), Wind Chimes, Party Speaker
• 🕶️ Hippy Glasses (drawn on your face!), Hemp Hoodie & Pastel Hoodie
• 💌 A starter letter from Pierre with seeds
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[b][size=5]🗂️ at [/size][/b]Robin's You can now PURCHASE:
[list]
[*]🍃 Stoner Stove (800g)[/*]
[*]🍃 Stoner Oven (900g)[/*]
[*]🍃 Stoner Blender (900g)[/*]
[*]🍃 Coffee Press (900g)[/*]
[*]🍃 Kettle (800g)[/*]
[/list]that turn dried buds into five new buffing drinks, 2 per bud. Every batch machine takes the whole stack you drop in and processes all of it.
[list]
[*]Topical Table (750g)[/*]
[/list]turns Infused Olive Oil into Hemp Salve, Hemp Lotion and Bath Bombs.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌈 THE COMPLETE GREEN-TO-LILAC UI (NEW!)
A full tie-dye recolor of the whole interface! Turn it on in Generic Mod Config Menu (or type stonerville_ui on in the SMAPI console), turn it off any time if you use another UI mod.
• 💚💜 Every menu page fades from kush green to lilac: inventory, skills, social, map, crafting, collections, options and more
• 🌈 A rainbow trim and pot leaves on the corners of every big menu
• 🗂️ Tabs, buttons, the clock, the gold box, the quest button and the toolbar all match. No orange left behind!
• 🍃 Over 200 menu pictures recolored. Nothing from the base game is shipped, it is all done while you play
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎬 THE ANIMATED MAIN MENU (NEW!)
• 🍃 Pot leaves AND the fresh buds of every strain we offer drift down the title screen, swaying and spinning
• 💜 The whole screen fades from green to lilac, with a purple glow behind the Stardew Valley logo
• 🌿 Big pot leaves frame the New, Load, Co-op and Exit buttons
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🍰 NEW FOODS & INFUSIONS (NEW!)
16 kitchen recipes cooked at your farmhouse stove, known from the start, each with its own buff:
• 🍎 Caramel Apple on a Stick, ☕ Hot Cocoa, 🍬 Peppermint Bark, 🍫 Chocolate Bar and 🪱 Sour Gummy Worms, each from its own strain's dried bud
• 🍕 Munchies Pizza, 🌮 Nachos, 🥞 Pancake Stack and 🍚 Rice Crispy Treat from any dried bud, and 🍫 Fudge from Cannabutter
• 🍯 Infused Honey (dried bud + Honey) and 🫒 Infused Olive Oil (dried bud + Oil), made in the Infusion Pot
• 🍰 Honey Cake, Honey Granola Bar, 🍝 Pesto Pasta, 🥖 Garlic Bread, Bruschetta and 🥕 Veggie Medley use the infusions
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📖 THE STONER'S BIBLE (NEW!)
A holdable green leather guide book with gold flowers on the cover. It arrives in the mail with a letter from Pierre (day 1 on a new save, the next morning on an existing save). Hold it and click to open it: the cover swings open to a two-page guide with the whole grow loop, every machine, rolling and smoking, edibles and concentrates, all 12 crosses, orders and Dealer Rep, the Stoner's Shed, furniture and storage, the festival, settings and a picture index of all 31 strains (seasons, days and prices read live from your game). 
Text is measured and wrapped so nothing runs off a page. Mouse, keyboard and controller. 
Pierre sells a spare copy for 250g. 
The letter is sent only once per player, and each strain in the index lists the seasons it grows in.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🛠️ INSTALL
1. Install SMAPI & Content Patcher.
2. 🗑️ DELETE any old Mods/StonerVille and Mods/StonerVilleGlasses folders first!
3. Unzip & drop StonerVille_AllInOne into your Mods folder.
4. Play & shop at Pierre's! 🛒
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Manifest.Name: StonerVille 2.0
Manifest.Description: Adds 30 weed-style strains with seeds at Pierre's, processing machines, edibles, joints, hand pipes, dealer letters and orders, Share a Joint, hand-selling, the Higher Vibez Festival, lava lamps, a Garden Tent, stash jars, shelves, boxes and containers, incense burners, gypsy hippy furniture, wallpapers and floors, retro diner signs, floor-to-ceiling animated Bubble Tubes, an optional kitchen, the free Stoner's Shed farm building (a blank square room plus a fireplace room to decorate) and an optional UI recolor. Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded and Almanac mods.
Manifest.Author: Nesryn Astra Rose
